senses.gloss: (v. גּוּף) to bend, to join; to press, close; v. גָּפַס.

units: <cite ref="Yoma 66b:13">Yoma 66ᵇ</cite> <he>גי׳ ונשק</he> Ar. (ed. <he>גפף ונישק</he>) whosoever embraces or kisses an idol; <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 7:6">Snh. VII, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 60b:2">60ᵇ</cite>) <he>המְגַפֵּף</he>.—
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 26:1">Pesik. R. s. 26</cite> <he>גִיפְּפָן וכ׳</he> he hugged and kissed them.

Ib. מְגַפְּפוֹת את וכ׳ threw their arms around the columns.—Y. Keth. VII, 31ᶜ מְגַפְּפִין סוטה if they have been seen embracing one another, she is amenable to the law of Sotah (v. סוֹטָה); a. fr.—Part. pass. מְגוּפָּף closed, enclosed, surrounded from all sides. Y. Kil. IV, 29ᵇ bot.; Y. Erub. I, 19ᶜ מְגוּפֶּפֶת וכ׳ enclosed on four sides; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Bekhorot 4:16">Tosef. Bekh. IV, 16</cite> <he>שאזניה מְגוּפָּפוֹת וכ׳</he> whose ears are closed.

senses.gloss: to lock up, shut. Y. Sabb. XIII, 14ᵃ bot. [read:] ולא כמֵגֵף לתוכה וכ׳ we are not treating the case of one shutting (the animal) up in the vivarium; (Y. Bets. III, beg. 61ᵈ בנָעַל).
